Instead of directly asking the LLM to evaluate the correctness of a reasoning step, SELFCHECK prompts the LLM to independently regenerate the step and then compares the generated step with the original one to determine its correctness. This approach leverages the generative capabilities of LLMs to create a more robust verification mechanism. The method is evaluated on three mathematical reasoning datasets: GSM8K, MathQA, and MATH, demonstrating that SELFCHECK can improve the accuracy of final answers compared to baseline methods. The authors also explore the use of weighted voting to combine multiple generated solutions, further enhancing performance.
